findings.summary: In the left panel the EFIT lower null and the solved lower saddle are drawn about 6.4 px apart on the 1399 px canvas while their glyphs span roughly 10 to 14 px, so the filled dark cross and the blue hollow cross overlap and read as one clustered mark at a glance; the caption promises that the larger dark reference marker stays visible beneath the blue one, and both are individually traceable on inspection, so the reader can recover the two points. The numeric offsets this figure argues about are printed under the panels, so the overlap costs readability rather than the finding.

notes: Read-only figure review of the five rendered PNGs named in this review. Only those PNGs were opened, plus crops and downscales of them for close inspection; no SVG and no other image was read, and no file was edited, created, moved, deleted, redrawn, relabelled or reformatted. Each PNG was matched to its figure path by the residual, convergence flag and lower-X-point offset printed under its panels, checked against the reviewed evidence table at docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-single-kernel-coupling.html. The earlier figure review of this run at 9ff3d99fd0c3c19f03f42bcd3e7de2c338baf890 recorded one blocking finding: two of the five difference-map contour levels were not separable at the size the figure is read. That defect was re-checked at this head and is repaired — the level styles now read apart at 900 px, and the highest level is carried out of the blue ramp in magenta with a direct callout — so no blocking finding is carried forward. Verdicts and contrast figures were measured from the pixels: the ink bounding box of every image lies inside the canvas with a clear border on all four sides, and white covers 88.7 to 93.6 percent of each canvas. Captions in the pages describe the measurement, the display convention and the recovery provenance rather than repeating a figure title, so no caption finding is recorded. The one finding recorded is non-blocking and display-only. No suite runs for a figure review, so added_failure_count is 0 with an empty id list.
